integrity: The proof is self-contained and does not depend on extrapolating finite data. Finite verification is supplied as reproducible corroboration. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary words with exactly three ones and scattered subsequences of length three. The exact rational generating function was already proposed without a proof as Conjecture 1 of Chrisnata et al. (available in 2021); the proved all-length identity and fiber involution, not the formula as a conjecture, constitute the contribution. A prior unindexed proof remains a priority risk. The cited first-public date belongs to the recent motivating 2026 source, not to the older conjecture.
title: Proof of the weight-three binary three-deck enumeration conjecture
